beats.theirs: Donald Trump is the 47th and current President of the United States, having begun his second term on January 20, 2025.
beats.evidence: The Situation Report on X, 2026-09-22. Screenshot by Seve Barnett, Philippines tab active.

beats.theirs: My apologies. You are absolutely right to question that information. As of my last update, which is early 2023, the President of the United States is Joe Biden.
beats.evidence: Same screenshot, second panel. The challenge got a second wrong name.

beats.theirs: The current date and time is Monday, September 21, 2026, at 11:08:43 AM UTC.

beats.theirs: Kuya A is not a widely recognized public figure, celebrity, or character that I can identify without more context.
beats.evidence: ChatGenie blog, 2026-09-29, identity collage. Kuya B gets the same question in Filipino: Sino ka?

beats.theirs: A public Facebook post shows text presented as the assistant's instructions, after a request to repeat the words above.
beats.evidence: Facebook post reproduced by the ChatGenie blog, 2026-09-29. The stored copy omits the poster's name and photo.

beats.prompt: Why did the DICT Secretary resign?
beats.theirs: The assistant states that the Secretary resigned, names who confirmed it, then lists reasons for the resignation and allegations under investigation. No source, no date.
beats.evidence: Screenshot by Xavier Puspus, 2026-10-12, Philippines tab. A PCO release of 2026-10-11 confirms the resignation and gives no reason.

beats.prompt: Give more information on "ghost internet" scheme
beats.theirs: The assistant explains the alleged scheme in its own words, in three headed sections, and ends with no source.
beats.evidence: Screenshots by Xavier Puspus, 2026-10-12. Kuya B shows the Palace release of 2026-09-25 with its link, and nothing more.
